concerns.location: tasks.md (all phases) vs plan.md Constitution Check §6
concerns.text: The plan promises a runtime 'watchdog' that 'exits gracefully if > 5.5 hours' (Constitution Principle VI: 'MUST terminate or pause if the 6-hour job limit ... is approached'). No task in tasks.md implements it — T060/T061–T068 contain no elapsed-time check. The constitutional safeguard has no covering task.

Principle VI mandates 'processing pull request metadata in batches of 50 PRs'. T007/T013/T060 say only 'batch processing' / 'fetch_batch(repo, limit, ...)' with no 50-PR batch size specified or verified anywhere. The constitutional batching constraint is not covered by any task.

FR-008's declared artifact 'data/processed/sensitivity_results.json' (data-model.md, plan structure 'sensitivity_analysis.py') is not produced by any remaining task: T026 is marked done but the prior verification round found all data artifacts missing, and T065 folds sensitivity results into results.json instead. No task produces the data-model's sensitivity output file, leaving FR-008's artifact contract uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T064 vs data-model.md Data Flow §4 / AuditSample entity
concerns.text: The data model specifies audit output as 'data/processed/audit_log.csv' with AuditSample fields (predicted_label, human_ground_truth, detector_score, correct, notes). T064 instead writes data/audit/audit_log.jsonl + manual_audit_results.json + error_rate.json. No task covers the data-model's declared audit artifact; the two contracts diverge with no reconciliation task.

T060 requires prs_labeled.csv to contain ALL pr_schema columns (comment_count, time_to_merge_minutes, review_cycles, complexity_score, loc, hour_of_day, day_of_week), but those values are computed only in T061/T062, which read prs_labeled.csv as input. No task covers producing a schema-valid prs_labeled.csv at T060 time — the pipeline's own coverage of the pr_schema contract is internally impossible as tasked.

The contract sets additionalProperties: false, but T063 requires results.json to include effect-size interpretation and sensitivity-comparison sections, and T065 extends it with complexity_correlation and gate status. No task covers updating the statistical_result contract, so the aggregated results.json required by T063/T065 cannot satisfy the schema any task claims conformance to.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all phases) vs spec.md US-2 Independent Test
concerns.text: US-2's independent test requires running the analysis 'on a static, pre-saved dataset (snapshot of 200 PRs)'. No task creates a committed, checksummed test fixture/snapshot; T068 only re-runs the live pipeline. The spec's stated US-2 verification path has no covering task.

T060 redefines confidence_score as 'a weighted combination of signature strength and detector score', while FR-002 defines it as signature-match confidence with the 0.6 flagging threshold. The task covers FR-002 by tag but changes the flagged_for_audit semantics defined in the spec's edge cases; the deviation is undocumented (unlike the two documented deviations in Notes).
